push_headlines: Asia sold off ahead of AI earnings: the Nikkei 225 -1.28%, the KOSPI -3.61%.
Brent near $109.70 and WTI near $103.92 as oil resumed its climb.
Riots in France are weighing on European sentiment; no same-day index closes found.
on_notice: Results from AI bellwether companies, which drove Tuesday's Asian selloff.
French unrest and sovereign risk, and whether it spreads beyond France.
Oil near $109.70 Brent after Trump's order waiving some sanctions and tariffs on Russian energy.

asia.headline: Asian stocks fell broadly: the Nikkei 225 -1.28%, the KOSPI -3.61%.
asia.detail: The MSCI Asia ex-Japan index -0.93% as geopolitical risks rattled sentiment ahead of key results from AI bellwether companies. CNBC's earlier opening report showed smaller losses, so intraday figures differ.

china.headline: No usable same-day Hang Seng or Shanghai close found tonight.
china.detail: Searches returned only older sessions, so no index levels are quoted here.

europe.headline: No usable same-day Europe index close found; French riots are the theme.
europe.detail: The dollar held firm against the euro as riots in France fuelled safe-haven demand. One analyst said French sovereign risk is being priced into European equities, but the euro's resilience suggests it is not yet seen as a systemic European problem.

latam.headline: No usable same-day Latin America report found tonight.
latam.detail: Searches returned only older sessions, so no index levels are quoted here.

mideast.headline: Brent near $109.70 as oil resumed its climb.
mideast.detail: Brent was around $109.70 and WTI around $103.92 in CNBC's morning report. Traders weighed a Trump executive order that waived some sanctions and tariffs on Russian energy.
